title: Page 120
transc:
Bermuda Landing May 10 . 1864 
Geo D Sheldon
my cifer of feeble Columns says down pledge down
feeble up plug down paddle up plank down penny
up plunder down perfume up person down poney compare
with yours Cant translate your sifer repeat it soon
R OBrien


Ft Monroe May 11 . 1864 
Maj Eckert Dil
for Bender zebra pension tugs will leave for grapes at
once pekin will send another tonight if it arrives from
blubber zodiac Knave has ordered weaselers to be held at
Bermuda hundreds sufficient to carry plaster promise Squash and corresponding
amount of pacific and negro unity Have forwarded supplies for
mandate days C S stores and harsh days shaker pedlar
large amount of offal Pekin am ordered to increase supply
of shade to laugh days for postpone purple animals zebra
what water wherry can be spared am sending to France
Baptism Hill town head pedlar to Shelby Rucker such propellers
as he has required unity am collecting considerable corn and
fodder from farms France saco Powhattan and Wilsons landing Zodiac
Shelter Kautz arrived at black yesterday Walrus pandora Biggs Vinton
Geo. D. Sheldon


Washington May 12 1864
Geo D. Sheldon & OBrien
in no plug penfield erase the name of
shelter Hurlbut and insert in its place the 
name of Taunton shelby Ed R S Canby
A Stager
